title: JCPenney - Omni International Mall
address:
1701 Biscayne Blvd
Miami, Florida 33132
United States
description:
BDI Construction is carrying out a full building demolition of the former JCPenney department store at Omni International Mall in Miami, bringing down the multi-level structure to clear the site for its next phase.

Work is ongoing, with remodeling and repair underway across the broader mall property as part of this landmark Biscayne Boulevard redevelopment.
